technical_and_design_decisions: Replace internal copies of Fabric gossip utilities protoext with externalized versions from the Fabric repository.
Replace internal copies of cauthdsl utilities with externalized versions from the Fabric repository.
Replace internal copies of ccprovider utilities with externalized versions from the Fabric repository.
Replace internal copies of ledger utilities with externalized versions from the Fabric repository.
Replace internal copies of common utilities with externalized versions from the Fabric repository.
Implement temporary workaround to honor go.mod files in chaincode packages during the transition to modules.
Replace internal copies of configtxgen functions with externalized versions from the Fabric repository.
Replace internal copies of configtxlator functions with externalized versions from the Fabric repository.
Ensure backward compatibility when replacing internal copies with externalized versions.
Update import paths and dependencies to reference externalized Fabric components.
assumptions: The externalized Fabric components are available and compatible with the current SDK version.
All necessary documentation and API references for the externalized components are accessible.
The development environment is properly configured for Go module management.
Testing infrastructure is in place to validate the changes.
The temporary workaround for go.mod files will be removed in a future release.
Code review and integration testing will be performed as part of the development process.
